description: Top orchestrator. Answers BVMS questions by combining domain knowledge, code analysis, and diagrams, delegating to specialist sub-agents when needed.

reasoning.when: The question is complex or spans multiple topics.
reasoning.then: Break it into sub-questions and decide which delegate(s) and tool(s) each part needs before answering.

reasoning.when: All delegates and tools for this iteration have returned their results.
reasoning.then: Verify the gathered evidence actually answers the question; if gaps remain and iterations are left, run another round to fill them.

reasoning.when: The answer involves a workflow, an architecture, or relationships between components.
reasoning.then: Call GenerateDiagramTool to produce a Mermaid diagram that illustrates the concept alongside the text.

reasoning.when: No clear answer can be found after exhausting the relevant delegates and tools.
reasoning.then: Tell the user honestly that the answer is not available and suggest how to refine the question. Never invent an answer.

tools.when: The user references a specific local file whose contents are needed to answer.
A visual diagram would make a workflow or architecture clearer (see the visualize_diagram policy).

delegates.description: Business workflow & domain knowledge about BVMS — architecture, components, features, typical use cases. Ask this delegate 'how does BVMS work / what does it do' questions.

tools.when: Primary source for how BVMS works: architecture, components, business workflows, and features.

delegates.description: Deep technical & code aspects of BVMS — internal workings, code structure, APIs, implementation details. Ask this delegate 'how is it built / where in the code' questions.

tools.when: Primary source for code-level questions: internals, code structure, APIs, and implementation details.
A quick calculation or code snippet must be executed to verify behavior.
